title: stardust rollout/rollout.json
description: Top-level config + run summary for a full-site rollout to AEM Edge Delivery Services. Owned by stardust:rollout. Keeps all platform/full-site state out of the agnostic core (state.json is never touched).

target.description: Delivery target. Fixed to AEM Edge Delivery Services for this proposal.

da.description: DA (da.live) destination coordinates for the DA Source API push.

liveHost.description: Resolved aem.live host, e.g. main--site--org.aem.live (with or without a scheme; scripts normalise on read).

outsideInventory.description: What an internal link to a path that is no coverage row does to the page: fail = the page is failed; warn = recorded in delivery.outsideLinks, the page stays verified.

waves.description: scripts/wave.mjs configuration (reference/waves.md § Stage table, § State): stage COMMAND overrides (the class is fixed in the driver's table), ledger / content paths, the preview origin and extra close commands. Absent = every default.

stages.description: Keyed by stage name — capture | build | content | convert | lint | local-gate | deploy | live-gate | publish | pixel, and the close steps verify | dashboard. `cmd: null` disables a close step; a hard stage left without a command whose artefact is missing is a start-time exit 2, never a silent pass.

cmd.description: Command template; placeholders {slug} {path} {url} {type} {file} {webPath} {migrated} {pathsFile} {previewOrigin} {waveId} {org} {repo} {branch} {content} {rolloutDir} {reportDir}. A batch command carrying --force is refused (exit 2).

class.description: Informational: the driver keeps its own class and prints a line when this differs.

ledger.description: deploy-batch ledger the driver reads rows from (default <content>/.deploy-ledger.json); regate-list --json reads the same file.

previewOrigin.description: Live-gate + verify origin (default https://<ref>--<site>--<org>.aem.page from site.da).

close.description: Extra close commands (same placeholders), run after verify / dashboard; logged, never a park.

lastRun.description: Summary of the most recent rollout run (the dashboard headline reads this).

ewHeld.description: Blocks past pending whose delivery.ewGate is fail | unmeasured — not counted as converted (measured-gates.md § Gate 6).

gates.description: Site-wide roll-up per ingested gate, recomputed from every coverage row's delivery.gates.<name> by update-coverage --gate / verify --ai-readability (reference/measured-gates.md § Gate 5, § Gate 6). The Phase H Readability / Editability lines are computed from here, never typed.

below.description: Measured pages with code < min (each is a failed row).

unmeasured.description: Rows the instrument gave no verdict for — never counted as failed.

min.description: The bar, copied from the artifact (never retyped).
